grain: One source-qualified objective proposition within an entry side, with all four entries/eight sides retained in coverage. Propositions and cross-entry result references are not extra engagement weights.
evidence_rules: Inspect every adopted quotation in its pinned section and any linked pinned facsimile; keep exact source ID, locator, raw hash, metadata hash and image hash.
Index all eight existing objective claims and retain the disposition of their citations; draft labels do not establish a prior objective or attainment.

Keep reported prior intent, a contemporaneously dated pre-action document, retrospective interpretation, speculative motive and inference from observed resistance distinct. A narrative reports an earlier intention without proving when it was recorded or known.
Keep prescribed action, intended military effect, broader goal and expected consequence distinct. Carrying out an attack is not proof of strategic benefit.

Record observed result separately, with source-qualified time/area and exact match or gap against the proposition. Victory, surrender, resistance or a later departure does not establish every objective.
Preserve alternative clocks, scopes, authorities and source dependence. Later events may illustrate follow-through but cannot be silently assigned to the battle or summed as independent outcomes.

Unknown objective, timing, criterion or result stays null with a reason. Do not invent a deadline, synchronised time, causal credit, ordinal score, utility weight, force-preservation total or replacement pool.
decision_rules: Assess descriptive components separately from common graded outcomes. Retrospective source-supported components may be retained with their provenance limits.

A comparable grade requires defended objective/success criteria, population, timing and aggregation across the included cases; a tally of heterogeneous objectives supplies none of these automatically.
Report whole-group/side coverage and component-specific denominators. Do not treat more listed objectives as more opportunity, value or command contribution.
No numerical grade, new model input, historical fit, final-set use or automatic wider extraction is authorized.
